activation_condition: the complete 25-pair released_dynamic pilot fails the preregistered foot-sliding criterion

single_factor_change.released_dynamic: recompute the released stationary-and-grounded predicate from current optimized joints every iteration
single_factor_change.frozen_initial: evaluate that exact predicate on iteration-0 joints once and reuse the detached boolean mask for all 100 iterations

frozen_unchanged_settings.foot_velocity_loss: mean of squared x/y/z velocity elements selected by the mask

comparisons: frozen_initial versus identical random_shape_reference for the unchanged full-augmentation authorization gate
frozen_initial versus released_dynamic on the same samples for the single-factor causal contrast

authorization_gate.decision_policy: all criteria pass; no threshold may be relaxed after observing results

prohibited_changes: changing the foot velocity from three axes to horizontal-only
changing foot indices, height thresholds or speed threshold
changing samples, donor shapes, timing, contact regions, seed, optimizer or iteration count
using validation/test generator metrics to authorize augmentation
